hero.name: Matheus Gaspar
hero.tagline: I lead backend teams in .NET and Python and build AI agents that run in production — with SOLID, DDD and Clean Code at the core.

about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Software Engineer and Tech Lead at Dattos, where I lead the backend team — defining architectures, mentoring on best practices and ensuring delivery quality, while staying hands-on in .NET and Python.
At Web7 Soluções, my own company, I design and run SaaS products — such as Auri, a WhatsApp AI agent that reduces no-shows at clinics — on a Kubernetes cluster I keep 100% in GitOps.
I use AI on two fronts: in the product, with agents that call tools, LLMs from several providers and MCP; and in my workflow, to ship faster without giving up SOLID, DDD and Clean Code.
I'm actively involved in agile projects with Scrum, prioritizing collaboration, effective communication and sustainable, high-quality software.

experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: From technical leadership to code — a track record of building and scaling software.

items.description: Technical leadership of the backend team: architecture, technical standards, mentoring and quality governance. Building APIs, microservices and complex integrations in .NET and Python.
Built efficient solutions with .NET Core, Entity Framework and Vue.js, applying SOLID, DDD and Clean Code in agile projects with Scrum, code review and system optimization.

Freelance projects since 2014 and a company since 2018. I design, build and run SaaS products and custom systems: Auri (a WhatsApp AI agent), Agent Studio, the Pulso marketplace, ERPs and my own Kubernetes platform with GitOps.
Led multiple full-stack .NET projects (C#, MVC, Vue.js), with Entity Framework, Dapper, PostgreSQL, AWS, microservices and Clean Code.
End-to-end full-stack development with C#, .NET, Vue.js and SQL Server, across traditional and agile methodologies.
